Renee Soto: Heads up 1: customers in the Satellite cohort asked for a short office hours focused on onboarding blockers + renewal signals. Proposed window: Tue 16:30 UTC (40m). Who can lead?
Liam O'Neill: I can take the first half (onboarding checklist + quick live debug). Can we tighten to 40m? Customers keep dropping long sessions.
Priya Rao: 40m works. Please include a 10m segment for churn-risk capture (account health review)  we'll want action items for any account with <30% weekly usage.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll support with a 10m segment on cost tips (batching, KV caching, quantization tradeoffs). Also can we get a list of attendees so I can prep model-room examples?
Renee Soto: Good call. I'll ask AMs to drop attendees. Agenda draft: 1) 5m intros + session goals 2) 10m onboarding checklist & blockers 3) 10m renewal-risk pulse (health dashboard walk) 4) 10m cost ops + tuning tips 5) 5m wrap & feedback form link.
Liam O'Neill: For the checklist I'll reuse this snippet: `Onboarding checklist: basic API key test, sample inference run, embedding sanity check, token usage baseline`.
Priya Rao: For renewal pulse please highlight these signals: weekly active calls, error rate spikes, NPS comment on latency, recent spike in support tickets. We'll tag accounts: Kestrel-Bio (low usage), NovaHealth (embedding accuracy concerns), Meridian Labs (data residency question).
CS Calendar Bot: Event created: "Satellite office hours  onboarding + health pulse" Tue 16:30 UTC (40m). RSVP poll attached: purpose = [onboarding,cost,SLA]. Link: https://calendar.redwood-inference.com/e/9f3d
Jorge Alvarez: I'll prepare two quick slides on batching and KV cache warmup (5 examples). Also will add a short code snippet in the pre-read:```python
# warmup cache
for _ in range(3):
    client.generate(prompt="warmup")
```
Renee Soto: Please make the pre-read <=1 page. We'll push to customers and AMs. Also capture feedback via a tiny form: 3 Qs (usefulness, follow-up needed?, topic priority).
Priya Rao: After the session I can run a 15m follow-up sync with any flagged accounts. Who should I cc? @Renee Soto @Liam O'Neill
Liam O'Neill: CC me for any live debugging follow-ups. I'll reserve 30m on my calendar after the event for deep dives.
CS Calendar Bot: Reminder: pre-read posted in event notes. Feedback form: https://forms.redwood-inference.com/r/officehrs-sat-1
Renee Soto: Thanks everyone. I'll lock the invite and ping AMs to submit attendee names + one-sentence asks by EOD tomorrow. If anything urgent, drop it here. :thumbsup:
